Sinner ruled out of Australian Open after knee surgery

Jannik Sinner · Sport

Organizers have confirmed that two-time Australian Open champion Jannik Sinner is out of the January grand slam at Melbourne Park after surgery on a persistent knee injury. Sinner said on Tuesday that he had a minor operation. Corriere dello Sport reports he faces up to four months out, and the world No 2 last played at Wimbledon in July.

Reported by The Guardian; BBC Sport; ESPN. Written by AI.
